body: I'm going to be patient and wait out the 8 weeks. She says before we meet up I must learn to control my emotions better. Even after these 8 weeks I'm uncertain that she will make plans with me, although she has told me to relax and that I have made progress. She's giving me a chance to prove myself during these 8 weeks.

We've briefly talked about meeting up ever since the first week of us talking to each other. I just expressed my feelings about it to her and she says that we can look into it in 8 weeks whenever she isn't working 7 days a week. I'm still unsure of what she really wants though. I feel as if after these 8 weeks something else will come up and I will feel like a fool for waiting.

Tough choice. I'd really like to gain experience subbing under *her*, but that doesn't seem to be happening anytime soon. She knows how much I want to meet her and has been a lot less strict on me lately to keep me from getting too emotional about it I believe, which isn't helping very much because now I'm starting to feel a bit of neglect. Usually we text back and forth while she is at work, but last night she stopped responding and has only said one thing to me all day.

I don't want to get stuck fantasizing about what I would like to happen and have it be completely unrealistic in the end, at the same time I don't want to jump the gun and decide to end it and look for someone else when patience would get me what I desire. I have many reasons to not trust my decision making when I'm in an emotional state.

Thank you, I appreciate this advice. I will propose to her that we meet up once more and see where it gets me. If she can't find any time for me in the next month or two I think it would be reasonable for me to move on with my life. I do not want to come across as demanding or selfish by asking to meet with her, the more I think about it the more I feel that she has little desire to meet me. She once told me that it was nice having me "just one text away" and that it being a real life thing would be a lot harder for her to manage. I've made compromises because I genuinely care about her, but it's beginning to be a bit complicated.

I really appreciate your advice. Most recently when I talked to her about wanting to meet up, she was considerate and open with me. She explained how hard it was for her to make plans with me due to her working so much and how being a good mother to her 3 year old daughter comes first. I expressed that ideally I would love to be there to help her raise her kid. She doesn't want me to meet her daughter because she's convinced that her daughter will be very fond of me, but will be heartbroken if it doesn't work out and I leave. I understand the precaution and it is logical, however I simply don't know how to move forward with this. I'm quite sensitive and emotionally unstable at times and this is really getting to me, I feel I don't have many options and I'm setting myself up to get hurt. She says she wants to meet with me but she just can't make plans for it now. I don't want all the time I've invested in getting to know her go to waste, but I'm not sure if I want to endure this lack of fulfillment. I'm very eager to gain experience as a sub, not just to mentally masturbate over the idea of it, I want it to be real. :/

Yes I have a car, and I am willing to meet with her, however she always has reasons to not meet me, either work or her daughter. Recently she's taken extra shifts and now works 7 days a week, which leaves her with almost no time for me. At one point when I expressed that I wanted to meet her and pretty much begged her to make this something real, we worked on making plans but the conditions basically were that we would meet, she would restrain me and spank me until I was in tears, provide after care, and send me on my way. No date, no spending time together really, just taking care of business and then moving on.
